title: AC1015 attributed INSERTs referencing an empty named block

source.provenance: From-scratch ezdxf 1.4.5 R2000 DXF; ODA File Converter 27.1.0 converted it to AC1015 DWG, then to ACAD2013 DXF; GNU LibreDWG 0.14 independently decoded the DWG. No DWG or DXF fixture is committed.
source.reproducer: tools/audit_ac1015_empty_attributed_insert.py author <input.dxf>; ODAFileConverter <input-dir> <dwg-dir> ACAD2000 DWG 0 0 '*.dxf'; ODAFileConverter <dwg-dir> <dxf-dir> ACAD2013 DXF 0 0 '*.dwg'; audit_ac1015_empty_attributed_insert.py verify <source.dwg> <output.dxf> <dwgread>
source.authority: ODA DWG v5.4.1 sections 20.4.9, 20.4.52 and common entity handle data; source wire role/ownership observations independently decoded with LibreDWG.
source.repeat: Full author/ODA/LibreDWG/ezdxf pipeline rerun and passed. Producer metadata makes byte hashes vary; verification checks the recorded topology and fields.

observedGraph.namedBlock: BLOCK_HEADER 0x8A name EMPTY_CHAIN, hasattrs 0, base (0,0,0), owner soft pointer to BLOCK_CONTROL 0x9; BLOCK and ENDBLK hard-owner references 0x8B and 0x8C; first and last block-content references are role-4 typed null; ordered insert references role 4 to 0x8E and 0x93.
observedGraph.boundaries: BLOCK 0x8B and ENDBLK 0x8C have entmode 0 and soft-pointer common owner 0x8A; their predecessor/successor are role-4 typed null. This independently produced source has no ATTDEF or other block content.
observedGraph.modelChain: LINE 0x8D -> INSERT 0x8E -> CIRCLE 0x92 -> INSERT 0x93 -> LINE 0x96. ATTRIB and SEQEND frames are not model-chain entries.
observedGraph.twoAttributeInsert: INSERT 0x8E has block-header hard pointer 0x8A, first/last attribute soft pointers 0x90/0x91 and SEQEND hard owner 0x8F. ATTRIB 0x90/0x91 common owners soft-pointer 0x8E; first prev typed-null and next relative +1, last prev relative -1 and next typed-null. SEQEND 0x8F owner soft-pointer 0x8E and prev/next typed-null.
observedGraph.oneAttributeInsert: INSERT 0x93 first and last soft pointers both target ATTRIB 0x95 and its SEQEND hard-owner reference targets 0x94. Both child and footer owners soft-point to 0x93; each has typed-null predecessor/successor. This source and ODA roundtrip retain exactly one attribute.

independentRoundtrip.odaResult: One DXF output; no .err. ezdxf independently decoded two INSERTs and exactly three attributes, and confirmed the named block contains no entities.

limits: This witnesses one empty ordinary named block and one/two attributed INSERT chains, not ATTDEF content, nested blocks, MINSERT, paper space, arbitrary block metadata, or all ATTRIB fields.

Source-produced and roundtripped bytes do not qualify generated libdxfrw output. Require separate independent generated-output role, semantic and ODA acceptance checks plus negative ownership, collision, caller-state and transaction tests.
